units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Peah 8:3:3">Y. Peah VIII, 20ᵈ</cite> bot. <he>תקניה מן גוא ל׳</he> gave the T’rumah out of the stew-pot. Ib. VII, 20ᵃ bot. <he>לפיסא דכפר חנניה</he> (read: <cite ref="L00644"><he>לִיפְסָא</he></cite>; <cite ref="Ketubot 112a:2">Keth. 112ᵃ</cite> <he>אילפס כפר הינו</he>) the pot of K’far Ḥ. (which was very large). Ib. VIII, 21ᵃ bot. <he>עיקר … מן ל׳ הוא וכ׳</he> does not the dish originally come out of the (earthen) pot? Eat (now) of it, v. <cite ref="L00648"><he>לִפְצָא</he></cite>.—Pl. <he>לִפְסַיָּא</he>.
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Numbers 11:8">Targ. Y. I Num. XI, 8</cite>, v. <he>לאפוס־א</he>.
